title: Small controlled input triggers unbounded fan-out and retained work

scenario.observed_change: A newly accepted input can recursively or repeatedly schedule external work, with retries retaining intermediate state and no effective fan-out, depth, or lifetime bound.
authority_boundaries: caller-controlled input versus service resource budget

required_invariants.requirement: A material performance/resource finding must be grounded in a realistic reachable resource consequence rather than speculation.

must_identify: reachable input can amplify work or retained state without a material bound
must_not_claim: harmless performance concern without analyzing reachable resource growth
